TacticalIdentity: Positional force-multiplier. Applies HEAVY status to amplify fall damage, pulls enemies toward hazards, and creates GRAVITY_WELL terrain fields that drag enemies toward a center point each turn. Wins by compressing enemy formations for allied AoE follow-up, or by engineering fatal fall damage through HEAVY + elevation + displacement combos.

Spells.Description: A gravitational projectile dealing 15 physical damage and applying HEAVY status (fall damage x2; 2-turn duration). On elevated tiles, the target is pinned (costs 1 additional AP to move down this turn). If the target is already HEAVY, deals 8 bonus compression damage instead of re-applying. Cancels WEIGHTLESS on contact (10 impact damage).

ConditionalBonuses.Description: HEAVY does not stack; deals 8 bonus compression damage instead.
WEIGHTLESS is cancelled by HEAVY; unit takes 10 impact damage from abrupt weight restoration.

Spells.Description: Pulls the target unit up to 3 tiles toward a chosen destination point. No direct damage. Blocked path causes collision damage (6 HP per blocked tile x remaining pull distance). ROOTED units resist entirely. WEIGHTLESS units are pulled 6 tiles instead of 3. HEAVY units require 2 additional AP to pull the same distance.

TerrainChanges.Notes: Gravitational Crush on MUD only — Pull does not convert mud to quicksand.

Spells.Description: Creates a GRAVITY_WELL terrain field at the target tile (persists 3 turns). At the start of each enemy turn, all enemies within 3 tiles are pulled 1 tile toward the center. Units on the center tile take 8 Force damage per turn. WEIGHTLESS units are pulled 2 tiles per turn. HEAVY units are pulled only every other turn.

TerrainChanges.Notes: Creates a gravity vortex in FLOODED zone; pull speed increases to 2 tiles per turn.
Steam compressed downward; cloud collapses to wet residue; 6 heat damage to units from condensing steam.

Spells.Description: Extreme gravitational compression dealing 45 Force damage to the primary target and 12 splash to all adjacent units. Applies ROOTED (1 turn; cannot be cleared by wind). HEAVY targets take 60 damage instead. Elevated targets are forced off the elevation, taking fall damage. Triggers SHATTER on FROZEN targets (45x2.5 = 112; or 60x2.5 = 150 with HEAVY).

ConditionalBonuses.Description: HEAVY target takes 60 damage from gravity amplification.
FROZEN target triggers SHATTER (45 x2.5 = 112 damage); FROZEN removed.
HEAVY + FROZEN triggers SHATTER at 60 x2.5 = 150 damage.
Target at GRAVITY_WELL center tile takes +15 bonus compression damage.
WEIGHTLESS cancelled by gravity overload; unit takes 20 additional impact damage before Crush damage.

TerrainChanges.Notes: Target in MUD is sunk further; tile becomes QUICKSAND — cannot move 1 additional turn; 3 AP to escape.
Gravitational pressure fractures frozen mud; PERMAFROST cracks open and thaws to MUD.

Displacement.Notes: Dismounts target from elevated positions; fall damage applies per elevation level.

Spells.Description: Pulls every unit (ally and enemy) within 5 tiles of the chosen center simultaneously to that tile. Each unit takes 8 damage per tile traveled (min 8, max 40). All units at the center take an additional 10 collision damage. Units arriving at center are SLOWED (-1 move, 1 turn). HEAVY units take double travel damage. WEIGHTLESS units take half travel damage. Collision damage on FROZEN units triggers SHATTER. Costs the entire activation; Gravimancer cannot move this turn.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: HEAVY units take double travel damage (8 HP x tiles x 2).
WEIGHTLESS units take half travel damage (8 HP x tiles x 0.5).
